##### Vector

##### Bug Fixes

- Keep role casing in app.kubernetes.io/component selector label ([#​621](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/helm-charts/issues/621)) ([6273ced](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/helm-charts/commit/6273ceda966dd66c4dca0a71c5beff9a9d4a2934))
  - 0.62.0 ([#​610](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/helm-charts/issues/610)) lowercased the role in the `app.kubernetes.io/component` label. This label is part of the immutable `spec.selector` of the DaemonSet, Deployment and StatefulSet, so `helm upgrade` from 0.61.0 to 0.62.0 fails with `field is immutable` ([#​620](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/helm-charts/issues/620)). This release restores the original role casing. Role matching stays case-insensitive.
  - Upgrading from 0.61.0 or earlier: no action. Keep the original role casing (`Agent`, `Aggregator` or `Stateless-Aggregator`). A failed upgrade to 0.62.0 leaves the Services and the PodDisruptionBudget with lowercase selectors that match no pods. Upgrading to 0.62.1 fixes this.
  - **BREAKING**: releases first installed on 0.62.0 have lowercase selectors, including releases that use the default `Aggregator`. To keep the existing selectors, set the role to lowercase (`role: agent`, `aggregator` or `stateless-aggregator`) before upgrading, and keep that value for later upgrades.
